cwe_mitigations.CWE-787: Apply the vendor firmware update. Disable network boot where it is not required.
cwe_mitigations.CWE-284: Enforce authorisation on every request rather than on entry. Apply the fixed firmware version.
cwe_mitigations.CWE-522: Credential material must never be retrievable through a management interface. Apply the fixed version and rotate any exposed credentials.
cwe_mitigations.CWE-20: Validate input against an allowlist at the trust boundary. Apply the vendor firmware update.
cwe_mitigations.CWE-501: Enforce the trust boundary in the bootloader lockdown policy. Apply the vendor update.
cwe_mitigations.CWE-1258: Apply the vendor firmware update and confirm debug interfaces are disabled in production builds.
